$comment: Public candidate contract with disabled semantics. governance_effect=none; authorization_effect=none; activation_effect=none.
title: XINGSHU Context Bridge Candidate Context Candidate
description: Portable public-candidate contract for an untrusted discovery or observation result. A Context Candidate is not a Registered Context Reference, has no active-use authority, cannot supply final authorization, and does not activate any runtime capability.

schema_version.description: Candidate contract identity only; not a release, adoption, or activation version.

candidate_id.description: Identity of this untrusted Candidate object.

discovered_name.description: Discovered or suggested human-readable name; not a registered canonical name.

source_id.description: Provider-neutral identity of the observed Source; it grants no Source access.

source_locator.description: Opaque observed Source identity or root anchor. Its presence does not authorize the entire root or any retrieval entry.

retrieval_hint.description: Optional non-authoritative hint for later review.

content_fingerprint.description: Optional fingerprint of an observed Source representation; it is evidence data, not freshness or authorization authority.

last_verified_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp for the Candidate discovery or Source observation evidence when verified. It is evidence linkage only, not an authorization, AI freshness assertion, registration record, or active-use authority.

verification_evidence_id.description: Opaque pointer to the verification evidence for this Candidate observation. It is evidence linkage only and creates no authorization, registration, freshness authority, or active-use authority.

suggested_allowed_clients.description: Optional client suggestions only. This field does not create client access and may be empty.
